description: The activation primitive. Every pressable affordance in the system routes through it, so press, long-press, hover, focus, and haptics behave identically everywhere.

MUST: Render the pressed state within one frame of contact, using motion role press (50ms, linear down; fast, standard on release).
Resolve style from the state set only, never from raw pointer events.
Evaluate the interaction axis in this precedence, first match wins: disabled, pending, dragged, pressed, hovered, focusVisible, rest.
Treat pending as distinct from disabled: a pending control is non-interactive AND communicates progress; a disabled one communicates unavailability.
Recognise long-press at interaction.longPress (500ms) and fire haptics.impactLight at recognition.
Leave no trace when a gesture is cancelled: a long-press released or slid off before recognition does nothing, and the pressed state clears.
Activate on Enter and Space, and expose itself as a button to assistive technology.
Bind the focus ring to focus-visible only, painted outside the control's bounds at width 2 and offset 2, so it never shifts layout.
Meet the density minimum target: 44 at touch, 32 at pointer. The visual glyph may be smaller; the hit area may not.
Extend the hit area with padding or hit-test slop, never by scaling the visual up.
Activate anywhere on a full-width row, not only on the label.
Offer a pointer and keyboard equivalent for any gesture it hosts, in the same change that adds the gesture.
SHOULD: Warn in development when a target renders below the density minimum, so undersized targets fail loudly rather than shipping.
Keep at least spacing.s4 between adjacent hit areas so misses do not become mis-hits.
NEVER: Flash a colour or emit a ripple on press.
Probe the platform. Density, width class, and capability come from the resolved scope; no component issues its own platform check.
Gate hover on density. Hover renders whenever a mouse produces it, on any density, and is an enhancement rather than a home for capability.
Claim an edge swipe. Edge gestures belong to system and OS navigation.
Fire a haptic without an accompanying visible state change, or fire on request rather than on commit.

haptics.note: Haptics no-op automatically where there is no actuator; call sites never branch on platform. Reduced motion does NOT disable haptics.
